reason_for_version: V1 used a stricter Nov-Jan window based on the published core field season. The already-frozen detection amendment prospectively defined the breeding-season parser as Oct-Dec -> same start year and Jan-Mar -> previous start year. No behavioral rows had been opened, so the state and detection parsers are harmonized now rather than allowing two season definitions.

date_to_breeding_season_start_year.months_4_5_6_7_8_9: excluded/fail closed for primary breeding-season state and detection proxy

banding_season_to_cohort.format: four digits YYZZ representing consecutive austral years, e.g. 9495
banding_season_to_cohort.cohort_start_year: YY>=90 maps to 19YY; YY<90 maps to 20YY
banding_season_to_cohort.biological_age: age in breeding season y = y - cohort_start_year

unchanged: January never maps to its calendar year; it maps to the preceding austral season start.
No behavioral outcome was inspected in choosing V2.
Off-window Apr-Sep observations are not assigned to primary breeding-season states.
claim_boundary: Do not introduce a different state-season and detection-season mapping.
Do not expand Apr-Sep after behavioral outcomes are opened without an external metadata audit.
This is a pre-outcome harmonization, not an outcome-driven repair.
